additional_info.subject: RE: ID0376290-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R9 170002768] XF4 not reachable CRM:00797001206
additional_info.body:
Hello RC-DE Team,
We attempted to reboot the charger remotely, but this did not make the XF4 router reachable from PLC.
It might be a hardware issue. If so, the problem could be with,
LAN Cable:
Try changing the LAN cable between the XF4 and the switch.
Switch Port:
Try changing the LAN cable connected from the XF4 to another available switch port.
XF4 Router:
Check the XF4 router itself.
Please plan an onsite visit to check these components. We recommend carrying a spare router & LAN Cable and replacing it if necessary.
